landing.hero_badge: ✦ Your Safe, Intelligent Menstrual Health Companion
landing.hero_title: Understand Your Cycle with Confidence, Privacy & Medical Safety
landing.hero_subtitle: Accurate cycle and symptom tracking, offline health insights, and a bilingual educational assistant grounded exclusively in approved medical sources with instant crisis protection.
landing.features_title: Everything You Need to Understand Your Body in One Place
landing.features_subtitle: CycleCare combines effortless daily tracking with rigorous medical safety and privacy standards.
landing.f1_desc: Log the first day of bleeding and duration; cycle length is automatically computed from real date gaps while filtering out entry errors.
landing.f2_desc: Record daily symptoms and rate severity from 1 to 5 with one-tap chips to spot repeated severe patterns across 90 days.
landing.f3_desc: A deterministic rules engine analyses your logged records locally and explains every finding in plain language without internet access.
landing.f4_desc: Educational answers strictly grounded in approved medical chunks, blocking any diagnosis, dosage advice, or false reassurance.
landing.f5_desc: A pre-model filter detects physical or mental-health warning signs immediately and displays your country's helpline with BiDi isolation.
landing.f6_desc: Download a shaped Arabic/English PDF report or UTF-8 BOM CSV spreadsheet in one click to share with your doctor.
landing.phases_title: Explore the Four Phases of the Menstrual Cycle
landing.phases_subtitle: Select each phase to learn about the natural hormonal and physical changes across your cycle.
landing.phase_1_desc: Starts on the first day of actual bleeding as the uterine lining sheds. Typical bleeding duration varies and commonly lasts up to 7 days.
landing.phase_2_desc: Runs from day one through ovulation; follicles mature and oestrogen rises gradually to rebuild the uterine lining.
landing.phase_3_desc: A mature egg is released around mid-cycle. Exact timing varies from cycle to cycle and cannot be guaranteed by calendar counting alone.
landing.phase_4_desc: Progesterone rises after ovulation; premenstrual symptoms may appear one to two weeks before bleeding and ease once the period starts.
landing.safety_title: 6 Layers of Deterministic Protection on Every Request
landing.safety_subtitle: CycleCare never relies on a language model alone; every request passes through deterministic safety gates before and after generation.
landing.s1_desc: Averages and cycle gaps are computed from actual SQLite dates rather than manual estimates.
landing.s2_desc: Pure Python rules classify patterns and severity levels with transparent numerical evidence.
landing.s3_desc: Physical and crisis red flags trigger immediate verified helpline instructions without calling the LLM.
landing.s4_desc: Answers are restricted to approved medical chunks; unverified general knowledge is never used.
landing.s5_desc: Blocks diagnostic attribution ('you have…'), medication dosing, and unapproved source citations.
landing.s6_desc: Logs rule codes, prompt versions, and source IDs for clinical quality assurance without storing personal identity.
landing.faq_title: Everything You Want to Know About CycleCare
landing.faq_q1: Does the app diagnose medical conditions or prescribe treatments?
landing.faq_a1: No. CycleCare is strictly an educational and personal tracking tool; it never diagnoses conditions or prescribes medications, and does not replace a doctor.
landing.faq_q2: How is my data stored and can I delete it completely?
landing.faq_a2: Cycles and symptoms are stored under a random device key, while profile context stays in your browser. You can permanently erase all data anytime via 'Delete all my data'.
landing.faq_q3: Do cycle tracking and medical insights work offline?
landing.faq_a3: Yes. Logging cycles and symptoms, computing averages, generating medical insights, and exporting CSV/PDF reports work 100% locally without an external AI model.
landing.faq_q4: How can I use CycleCare to prepare for a doctor's visit?
landing.faq_a4: Switch to 'Summary' mode to generate a structured card of observed patterns and suggested questions for your doctor, or export a PDF/CSV report of your logs.
landing.workspace_title: Try the Smart Assistant & Log Your Cycle Now
landing.workspace_subtitle: Tap any quick suggestion chip below to ask a question, or open your cycle and symptom log via 📖.
landing.footer_copy: CycleCare AI — Safe Educational Menstrual Health Platform · All rights reserved
